entries.title: finite q_r orbit-count formula
entries.body: Let N_o be the number of represented q_o content classes and F the number fixed by reflection up to QO_EQ. Then the number N_r of q_r classes is (N_o+F)/2.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Partition the finite q_o classes into F singleton reflection orbits and (N_o-F)/2 two-class orbits.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: q_r class count bounds
entries.body: ceil(N_o/2) <= N_r <= N_o.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The fixed-point count satisfies 0<=F<=N_o.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: reflection quotient gives at most factor-two semantic-class compression
entries.body: Passing from q_o classes to q_r classes can reduce the number of semantic state classes by no more than a factor of two.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Every q_r orbit contains one or two q_o classes.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: task deduplication multiplicity is independent of q_r orbit size
entries.body: Arbitrarily many task occurrences may project to one q_r class even though that class contains at most two q_o classes.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Occurrence identity is a separate carrier and is not bounded by the size of the semantic reflection orbit.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: q_r alone cannot explain a semantic-class reduction larger than two
entries.body: Any reduction of distinct semantic q classes by more than a factor of two requires an equivalence other than the q_o->q_r horizontal-reflection orbit quotient.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The exact orbit-size bound is structural.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: effect-class histogram is q_r-invariant
entries.body: The counts of legal actions in effect classes 0,1,2 are constant on each q_r class.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Reflection bijects legal actions and preserves each effect token.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: orientation-free effect histograms may be shared by q_r
entries.body: An effect-class histogram, unlike literal per-column effect labels, can be reused across QR_EQ states without orientation metadata.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The histogram discards literal column coordinates and retains only q_r-invariant counts.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: literal per-column effect data requires the q_r transporter
entries.body: A cached mapping from literal column to EFFECT under q_r requires identity/reflection transport on lookup.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Effect tokens are equivariant, not literal-column invariant.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: promoted literal column is not an orientation-free q_r payload
entries.body: PROMOTE cannot be cached as a literal q_r-class property without preserving orientation/tie context.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The fixed center-order tie break prevents q_r invariance.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: q-step paths contain only non-immediate actions
entries.body: Every edge on a Q_STEP path represents an action for which the mover did not have OWN_WIN at the landing cell.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Q_STEP explicitly contains NOT OWN_WIN; immediate actions are represented by IMMEDIATE instead.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: an immediate winning action has no ordinary q successor
entries.body: IMMEDIATE(q,c,v) implies there is no qp with Q_STEP(q,c,qp).
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Immediate and successor branches are mutually exclusive.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: recursive VALUE descent crosses no represented first-win boundary
entries.body: Every recursive OUTCOME->Q_STEP->VALUE descent consists only of non-immediate actions; an immediate terminal action contributes its WDL directly and ends that branch.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: OUTCOME is an exclusive immediate-or-successor case under the Q_STEP guard.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: with extensional comprehension, rank-by-rank dynamic evaluation is exact
entries.body: Under the comprehension condition of IA-I202, VALUE can be evaluated from rank 42 downward because every dependency goes to the next rank and every q has a unique value.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Finite DAG plus total functional value supports exact reverse-rank evaluation.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: finite exact evaluation does not imply a small state space
entries.body: The existence of a finite rank-by-rank evaluation does not imply that the represented q_o or q_r content space is small.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The coarse finite q_o bound already contains two independent 625-bit residual membership spaces before antichain restrictions.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: q_r at most halves the q_o state-count bound
entries.body: Replacing q_o by q_r can at most halve any exact q_o class count; it does not supply further semantic state collapse by itself.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: This is the orbit-size bound applied to the finite semantic state space.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: conditional VALUE totality descends to q_r
entries.body: Under extensional comprehension, every q_r class has exactly one scalar VALUE token.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Every represented q has one value and that value is constant on q_r equivalence classes.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: scalar-plus-transporter is sufficient for q_r action/value reuse
entries.body: For an exact value-bearing action cache, the pair {q_r scalar value, orientation/action transporter applied to a value-preserving action witness} is sufficient to reuse both scalar and physical action semantics.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The scalar handles orbit-invariant value; the transporter handles the only represented coordinate change.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: scalar and oriented-action cache layers can be separated without semantic loss
entries.body: A cache may store q_r scalar VALUE independently from an optional orientation-sensitive exact action witness, provided the witness keeps its value proof and transporter context.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The two payloads have distinct but composable semantic reuse contracts.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: q_o action caches need no reflection transporter
entries.body: Within QO_EQ, an exact literal action/value witness may be reused with the same literal column label.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: q_o future congruence preserves literal action labels by identity rather than reflection.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass

entries.title: remaining open regions are not implicit-assertion consequences
entries.body: The current exact IA closure does not derive extensional carrier comprehension, runtime fairness/termination, net sharing speedup, or unrendered representation-equivalence semantics.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Each item still has an explicit missing premise or QU boundary; admitting it would violate no-hidden-premise discipline.
entries.downstream_relevance: final material assertions before fixed-point pass
